goal: Measure whether the current Web Hand completes bounded Korean multi-hop and closed-set work accurately, completely, honestly, and efficiently before changing the product.

benchmarkBoundary.kBrowseComp: Two deterministically selected items from the official 300-item verified JSONL, graded for gold-answer equivalence by a separate model. This is not an official leaderboard run or a representative full-benchmark score.
benchmarkBoundary.koWideSearch: The official gated gold was not accessed. Two T5-authored public Korean policy tasks adopt item, cell, and whole-row completeness only; no Ko-WideSearch score is claimed.
benchmarkBoundary.sourceAuthorityForKBrowseComp: not scored because the pinned public JSONL contains no source URL, expected trajectory, or checklist fields despite the repository README description

koWideSearch.publicRelease: project page and figures only; gated gold and runnable scorer absent from the pinned repository

repeatedDefect.cause: A completed web_research batch with 9 to 10 readable sources deactivated broad web_search while the multi-hop user purpose was still incomplete. Both models then used exec or many exact reads to recover missing branches, causing large receipt projection and context growth.
repeatedDefect.wrongFinalAnswerFamily: Both models answered K-BrowseComp sample 29 with 38.8 percent instead of the gold-equivalent 18.8 percent after selecting the wrong evidence chain.
repeatedDefect.performanceBoundary: The two hard tasks dominate 93 to 97 percent of each model's measured tokens; the closed-set official tasks complete exactly with far fewer turns.

rejectedChange.change: Keep web_search visible after a completed web_research batch and instruct the model to continue only a focused missing branch.

terraCounterexample.observedFailure: exec bypass disappeared but was replaced by 27 focused web_search calls across the two hard tasks; accuracy fell and wall time nearly doubled

verdict.strength: Both models completed both Korean official closed-set work tasks with exact item, cell, whole-row, and official-source scores.
verdict.shortfall: The current bounded research continuation is not adequate for hard multi-hop Korean web work: both models scored 1 of 2 and paid very high context and wall-time costs.
verdict.next: W9 must test a bounded evidence-branch continuation that preserves missing-branch identity and budgets follow-up discovery; simply reopening web_search is explicitly disqualified.
